admin.title: Rewards
admin.subtitle: Points, store credit, gift cards and referrals. Switch the feature on when the rules are set.

tabs.label: Rewards sections
tabs.none: You do not have permission to see any rewards section.

settings.title: Rewards settings
settings.loadFailed: The settings could not be loaded. Please try again.
settings.readOnly: You can look at the rules but not change them. Changing them needs permission to adjust points.

enabled.title: Rewards feature
enabled.on: On: customers earn points when an order is delivered, can pay part of an order with points, store credit or a gift card, and see Rewards in their account.
enabled.off: Off: nothing is earned, customers see no rewards and cannot use points, credit or gift cards at checkout. Your staff screens keep working, so you can set the rules first.
enabled.stateOn: Saved state when you press Save: on
enabled.stateOff: Saved state when you press Save: off

fields.maxTenderPercent: Most of an order points and credit may pay
fields.referralRewardReferrer: Reward for the customer who referred

hints.earnRatePerBdt: For example 0.01 means one point for every 100 BDT of goods.
hints.earnRatePerBdtExample: That is {points} point for every {amount} of goods.
hints.pointValue: What one point is worth when it is spent.
hints.minPointsToRedeem: A customer must use at least this many points, or none. 0 means no minimum.
hints.maxTenderPercent: Points and store credit together. Gift cards are not capped.
hints.expiryWarningDays: A message is sent this many days before. 0 means no warning.
hints.referralRewardReferrer: Store credit, given after the new customer's first order is delivered.
hints.referralRewardReferee: Store credit for the new customer, given at the same time.
hints.giftCardMinAmount: Staff cannot create a card below this.
hints.giftCardMaxAmount: Staff cannot create a card above this.
hints.giftCardDefaultValidityMonths: Used when a card is created without an expiry date. 0 means never.

errors.range: This number is outside the allowed range.
errors.giftOrder: The largest card must not be below the smallest.

cards.title: Gift cards
cards.loadFailed: The gift cards could not be loaded. Please try again.
cards.deactivated: The gift card is switched off.

create.title: Create a gift card
create.text: The code is shown once after you create the card. It cannot be shown again.
create.expiresHint: Leave empty to use the default validity from the settings.
create.send: Send the code to the recipient now
create.sendNote: One message with the code goes to the recipient by SMS and email where available. That message, and its log entry, contain the code.

errors.range: The amount must be between {min} and {max}.
errors.past: The expiry date cannot be in the past.
errors.needsRecipient: Enter a mobile number or an email to send the card to.

once.title: Gift card created
once.text: A card of {amount}. Here is its code.
once.warn: Copy it now and give it to the customer safely. After you close this window it cannot be shown again; only the last four characters are kept.
once.copyFailed: The code could not be copied. Select it and copy by hand.

detail.title: Gift card
detail.loadFailed: The gift card could not be loaded.
detail.codeHidden: The full code is never shown again. Only the last four characters are kept.

deactivateDialog.title: Deactivate this gift card?
deactivateDialog.text: The card ending {hint} with {balance} left can no longer be used. This cannot be undone.

referrals.title: Referrals
referrals.help: A referral is rewarded when the new customer's first order is delivered. A rejected referral shows the rule that decided.
referrals.loadFailed: The referrals could not be loaded. Please try again.

lookup.title: Customer rewards
lookup.searchHint: Type a mobile number or a name (at least 3 characters), or paste a customer id.
lookup.searchHintId: Paste the customer id. Searching by number needs permission to view customers.
lookup.noSearchPermission: You cannot search customers, but you can open one by pasting the customer id.
lookup.searchFailed: The search failed. Please try again.
lookup.inconsistent: Balances do NOT match the ledgers

adjust.title: Adjust points or store credit
adjust.text: Add with a plus or take with a minus. A balance never goes below zero. The change is written to the ledger with your name and reason.
adjust.signHint: For example 50 to add or -50 to take. Leave empty for no change.
adjust.reasonHint: Required. For example the call or ticket number.

errors.whole: Points must be a whole number.
errors.none: Enter points, store credit or both.

me.title: My rewards
me.subtitle: Your points, store credit, referral code and gift cards.
me.loadFailed: Your rewards could not be loaded. Please try again.

off.title: Rewards are not open yet
off.text: The shop has not switched rewards on. Nothing is lost: come back later.

me.expiring: {points} points expire on {date}. Use them before then.
me.creditHelp: Refunds to credit, gift cards and referral rewards live here.

how.title: How it works
how.earn: Earn {points} point for every {amount} of goods once your order is delivered. Delivery is not counted.
how.spend: Each point is worth {value}. Use at least {min} points on one order, or none.
how.cap: Points and store credit together can pay up to {percent}% of an order. A gift card is not capped.
how.expiry: Points expire {months} months after you get them.

referral.title: Refer a friend
referral.help: When a friend you refer gets their first order delivered, you get {referrer} store credit and they get {referee}.
referral.loadFailed: Your referral details could not be loaded.
referral.copyFailed: The code could not be copied. Select it and copy by hand.
referral.shareText: Use my code {code} on your first order at Juvo BD.
referral.limit: You can be rewarded for up to {max} referrals.
referral.referredAnon: A referral code is already used on your account.
referral.applyHint: You can enter it before your first order.
referral.codeInvalid: A referral code has 8 letters and digits.

gift.title: Redeem a gift card
gift.help: The card's value moves into your store credit. Use it on any order.
gift.hint: 16 letters and digits, with or without dashes.
gift.codeInvalid: A gift card code has 16 letters and digits.
gift.done: {added} added to your store credit. Your balance is {balance}.

tender.title: Rewards and gift cards
tender.help: Pay part of this order with points, store credit or a gift card. The prices and the total do not change; only what you still have to pay.
tender.noBalance: You have no points or store credit yet. You can still use a gift card.
tender.pointsHint: At least {min} points. Each point is worth {value}.
tender.pointsUnavailable: Points can be used from {min} points, within the share the shop allows.
tender.pointsBelowMin: Points can only be used from {min} points, so none were applied.
tender.adjusted: We lowered the amount to what you can use on this order.
tender.cap: Points and store credit can pay up to {percent}% of the order (up to {amount}).
tender.giftHint: A gift card pays as much as it holds, up to what is left to pay.
tender.guestNote: Sign in to use points and store credit.
